attributes.action: Increase government spending for end of life care.
attributes.additional_details:
Hospice UK reports 310,000 patients and 89,000 carers received care in 2024–25. By 2040, annual deaths will rise by 130,000. Up to 90% need palliative care, yet 1 in 3 currently miss out.

An immediate £50M funding boost will:
• Protect Staff: Secure wages for 13,250 clinical staff.
• Ease Strain: Reduce charity fundraising reliance.
• Expand Reach: Fund at-home visits for those left behind.

We cannot outsource dignity to charity. Government must fund hospice care now.
attributes.background:
UK hospices face a critical crisis: running them costs £2B annually, but government funding covers just £0.5B, leaving charities to raise  the remaining £1.5B. 

 1 in 3 dying people miss out on end of life care, these our are family and friends, and could be us. 

Sign this petition today!

rejection.details:
